meta.title: Scout
meta.description: The scout tool: search and read in a child process on a cheap model; the parent gets only the result, the child's spend goes to its own log row.

config.models: More scout models in order, tried before the parent model
config.modelSelection: Let the agent pick the scout model
config.callerMaxDepth: Deepest agent that may call the scout; empty means any
config.briefTokens: Brief cap from the parent, tokens
config.resultTokens: Result cap for the parent, tokens
config.childMaxTokens: Child output cap per step, tokens
config.profile: Profile label in the log row; empty means the DSH profile name
config.prices: Per-model prices overriding the built-in table
